notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to the number of creatures you control.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid to your hand and causing Temur Sabertooth to gain indestuctible until end of turn.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
